editorial:
Imagine getting out of prison after seven years only to find out your son was brutally murdered while you were away. That is the heavy setup you get here. You follow Victor, a former art thief who heads back to Moscow with one goal: find out who killed his boy. He is not alone, though. He has his lover Alexandra and his old partner Souliman, a choreographer, helping him dig through the dirt. The vibe is dark and gritty, feeling like a mix of a crime caper and a revenge story. It puts you right in the middle of a cold city where nobody is who they seem to be.

What really works is how the mystery unfolds. The action is punchy, and the acting makes you actually care about Victor's pain. While some parts of the plot move a bit slow, the payoff is worth it. If you love stories about fathers on a mission, you will dig this.
endingExplained: The mystery wraps up when you discover the murder was linked to a high-level conspiracy involving the very people Victor trusted. After a series of tense fights and chases, Victor finally corners the killers. He gets his revenge by taking down the corrupt officials responsible for his son's death. The movie ends with a sense of closure, showing that while he cannot bring his son back, he finally found the truth and settled the score.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves revenge stories and crime mysteries.
